claims.title: Product-vector support characterizes finite stochastic marginal-return preparation

scoped_dependencies.relation: Scoped contrast only: N680 concerns exact tensor restriction with an uncorrelated product-return catalyst and a different input contract. N691 concerns finite-dimensional state preparation from separable inputs with success-conditioned marginal return, allowing output–catalyst correlations. No implication, validation, or contradiction is asserted; target currently resides on unmerged PR #42.

Scoped contrast only: N683 concerns channel-level protocol replacement and sequential entanglement cost under its stipulated whole-protocol return conditions. N691 is a success-branch state-preparation relation. No proof dependency or status transfer; target currently resides on unmerged PR #44.

Conceptual contrast only: N685 studies early/late flags and resource-preserving causalization for channels. N691 studies state-level marginal return and its failure under later postselection. No proof dependency or claim equivalence; target currently resides on unmerged PR #46.

Scoped contrast only: N686 concerns exact channel superactivation with infinite-dimensional pure reservoirs; N691 is finite-dimensional state preparation with a finite Schmidt-number ceiling. No contradiction or transfer of hypotheses; target currently resides on unmerged PR #47.

interface: Finite bipartite state; separable inputs; finite catalyst; successful LOCC branch p>0; exact success-conditioned catalyst marginal, with output–catalyst correlation allowed.
criterion: Preparation iff range(σ) contains a nonzero product vector; equivalently σ has a positive-weight separable component.
limits: State preparation only. Marginal-return reachability is not transitive. Exact product return under every product-effect outcome is stronger. Linked verification code/results unavailable; proof and priority unreviewed.
